properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: This is classical RSA encryption/signing used throughout the MSAL client library for token signing, certificate operations, and key management. The library uses both RSA.Create() and RSACryptoServiceProvider directly in multiple locations for cryptographic operations.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT signed with RSA: classical, deadline-class quantum risk. This is used for Proof-of-Possession tokens in Microsoft Identity Client library. These are actual cryptographic signature operations, not just test constants.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hardcoded secrets in Microsoft Identity Client library. These are cryptographic materials (keys/secrets/tokens) that are embedded directly in the source code, making them vulnerable to exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Non-constant-time string/credential comparisons used throughout the MSAL library for token validation and security checks. These comparisons use standard equality operators instead of constant-time comparison functions.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: RSA-PSS signature algorithm used in Microsoft Identity Client for Proof-of-Possession operations. This is a classical cryptographic signature scheme that will be broken by quantum computers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) signature algorithm in Microsoft Identity Client test constants. This is for testing purposes but represents the cryptographic primitives used in the library.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Use of System.Random in security-sensitive contexts such as nonce generation and token creation. This is a weak random number generator that should be replaced with cryptographic secure alternatives like RandomNumberGenerator.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Static IV/nonce in iOS broker key helper - this is a cryptographic implementation weakness where the same initialization vector is used for encryption operations.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: HMAC-SHA-1 usage in Kerberos key types. This is a deprecated hash function that should be replaced with SHA-256 or higher.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: AES-CBC encryption mode used in iOS broker key helper - this is a cryptographic operation in the Microsoft Identity Client library for secure key handling.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: JWT ES256 (ECDSA) signature algorithm used for Proof-of-Possession tokens in Microsoft Identity Client. This is a classical cryptographic signature scheme that will be broken by quantum computers.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA usage in test certificate creation helpers. This is an elliptic curve signature algorithm that is also vulnerable to Shor's algorithm and needs post-quantum migration.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Usage of P-256 (secp256r1) elliptic curve in test certificate helpers. This is a quantum-vulnerable elliptic curve that needs migration to post-quantum alternatives like X25519 with ML-KEM.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Usage of P-384 and P-521 (asym-p384-p521) elliptic curves in test certificate helpers. These are quantum-vulnerable curves that need migration to post-quantum alternatives.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Usage of SHA-256 in certificate creation and token processing. This is a hash function that needs to be migrated to quantum-safe alternatives like SHA-3 or BLAKE2.
